    # Define domain [-1/4, 1/4] with equally spaced points

    g_norm_1 = np.sum(g_abs) * step_width
    
    # ||g||∞ (infinity norm)
    g_norm_inf = np.max(g_abs)
    
    return g_norm_2_sq, g_norm_1, g_norm_inf
